changelog: Security: the frontend auth guard no longer fails open. useAuth revalidated the session with a .catch() on a promise that never rejects, so a stale or hand-written localStorage entry rendered the full UI (including admin routes) without a login. It now branches on the validation result.
Security: CORS no longer reflects arbitrary origins with credentials. CORS_LOCK is enabled in the deployed environment; the allowlist is built from URBACKUP_SERVER_FQDN.
Security: GET /api/version/stats now requires authentication -- it reported fleet-wide installation counts to anonymous callers.
Security: the installId telemetry parameter is validated against ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11,64}$ before it reaches a database row. GET /api/version stays unauthenticated so remote installs can still check in.
Unmatched /api/* paths now return a JSON 404 instead of falling through to the SPA fallback and returning index.html with a 200, which made a missing endpoint look like a broken page.

The auto-update script shipped at the repo root pointed at https://stor.agit8or.net/downloads/urbackup-gui.tar.gz, which does not exist and -- because of the SPA fallback -- returned 200 text/html, so tar failed on an HTML page and every update rolled back. setup/auto-update.sh (GitHub releases) is the correct script.
The About page no longer shows the active-installation count.
